subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings hide/neutralize transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or may they expose existence metadata for those paths?
rationale: The linked repair path changes a gateway file metadata boundary, and automation should not choose whether external or fs-safe-rejected paths are hidden, neutralized, or intentionally exposed.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden or neutral in the rail, and the fix avoids raw filesystem stat calls outside the workspace boundary.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The gateway may return existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths, but that needs explicit tests and maintainer acceptance of the boundary change.

options.title: Split Layout From Metadata
options.body: Any still-needed CSS rail layout fix lands separately while backend file semantics are decided in a focused gateway change.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden or neutral in the rail, and the fix avoids raw filesystem stat calls outside the workspace boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent fs-safe workspace browsing and file preview work makes this the strongest owner for the boundary decision.
